senses.gloss: व्यंशक m. A mountain.
व्यंसक m. A rogue, a cheat.(मयूरव्यंसक ‘a cunning peacock.’)
व्यंसन n. Cheating, deceiving.
व्यक्त a. (f. क्ता) 1. Manifest, apparent, evident; 2. distinguished, specified; 3. wise, learned.(व्यक्तम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘clearly, evidently, manifestly.’)
व्यक्त a. (f. क्ता) 1. Manifest, apparent, evident; 2. distinguished, specified; 3. wise, learned.(व्यक्तम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘clearly, evidently, manifestly.’)
व्यक्त-गणित n. arithmetic.
व्यक्त-दृष्टार्थ m. an eye-witness.
व्यक्त-रूप m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.

व्यक्ति f. 1. Manifestation, visibility, indication, भवति भवतो यय्स् संयोगमेत्य स्नेहव्यक्तिश्चिरविरहजं मुंचतो बाष्पमुष्णम् Megh.i.12; 2. discrimination, distinction, सदसद्व्यक्तिंहतव R.i.10; 3. individuality, (op. to जाति); 4. a person, an individual; 5. source, origin, न हि ते भगवन् व्यक्तिं विदुर्देवा न दानवाः Bg.x.14; 6. gender (in gram.).
व्यग्र a. (f. ग्रा) 1. Bewildered, perplexed; 2. eagerly engaged in, zealously occupied with, (with a loc.), K.S.vii.2; 3. alarmed, frightened.
व्यग्र a. (f. ग्रा) 1. Bewildered, perplexed; 2. eagerly engaged in, zealously occupied with, (with a loc.), K.S.vii.2; 3. alarmed, frightened.
व्यंग (I) a. (f. गा) 1. Deformed, mutilated, wanting a limb; 2. bodiless.
व्यंग (II) m. 1. A frog; 2. a cripple; 3. dark spots on the cheek.
व्यंग (I) a. (f. गा) 1. Deformed, mutilated, wanting a limb; 2. bodiless.
व्यंगुल n. A minute measure of length equal to the 60th part of an Angula.
व्यंग्य n. Suggested sense, insinuation, (op. to वाच्य and लक्ष्य ‘the primary and secondary meanings of words and sentences’), व्यंग्येन रहिता रूढो सहिता तु प्रयोजने K.Pr.ii.
व्यच् vt. 6P (pres. विचति; pass. विच्यते) To deceive, to defraud.
व्यज m. A fan.
व्याज m. 1. Craft, deception, cunning; 2. contrivance, means, व्याजार्धसंदर्शितमेखलाणि R.xiii.42; 3. pretext, pretence, disguise, R.iv.25, xi.66.
व्यजन n. A fan, नृपतेर्व्यजनादिभिस्तत्मो नुनुंद R.viii.40, x.62.
व्यंजक (I) a. (f. जिका) 1. Making clear, manifesting, showing, indicating; 2. suggesting a meaning (applied to a word or sense), (op. to वाचक and लाक्षणिक).
व्यंजक (II) m. Gesticulation indicative of internal feeling, dramatic gesture.
व्यंजक (I) a. (f. जिका) 1. Making clear, manifesting, showing, indicating; 2. suggesting a meaning (applied to a word or sense), (op. to वाचक and लाक्षणिक).

व्यंजन n. 1. Making clear, manifesting, indicating; 2. a mark, a sign; 3. mark of sex, i.e. the male or female organ; 4. insignia; 5. a sign of puberty; 6. the beard; 7. a limb, a member; 8. sauce, condiment; 9. a consonant (in gram.); 10. the last of the three powers of a word by which it suggests a sense or senses.
व्यंजना f. The same as व्यंजन (10) q.v.
व्यंजन-संधि m. the junction of consonants.
व्यंजित a. (f. ता) 1. Manifested, made clear; 2. marked, characterized; 3. suggested.
व्यंजित a. (f. ता) 1. Manifested, made clear; 2. marked, characterized; 3. suggested.
व्यडंबक m. The castor-oil plant.
व्यडंबक m. The castor-oil plant.

व्यतिकर m. 1. Mixing together, mixture, intermixture, व्यतिकर इव भीमस्तामसे वैद्युतश्च M.M.ix., x., तीर्थे तोपव्यतिकरभवे जह्नुकन्यासरय्वः R.viii.95, Megh.i.15; 2. reciprocity, mutual relation; 3. alternation; 4. opportunity; 5. an occurrence, an incident; 6. misfortune, calamity.
व्यतिकीर्ण a. (f. र्णा) Mixed together, blended together.
व्यतिकीर्ण a. (f. र्णा) Mixed together, blended together.
व्यतिक्रम m. 1. Deviating, transgressing; 2. breach, violation, non-performance (as in संविद्व्यतिक्रम); 3. sin, vice; 4. adversity, misfortune; 5. inversion, reverse, contrariety.
व्यतिक्रांत a. (f. ता) 1. Passed over, elapsed; 2. inverted, reversed; 3. violated, neglected.
व्यतिक्रांत a. (f. ता) 1. Passed over, elapsed; 2. inverted, reversed; 3. violated, neglected.
व्यतिरिक्त a. (f. क्ता) 1. Surpassing, excelling, going beyond; 2. withdrawn, withheld; 3. different from, separate, न वृक्षवृत्तिव्यतिरिक्तसाधनः K.S.v.22.
व्यतिरिक्त a. (f. क्ता) 1. Surpassing, excelling, going beyond; 2. withdrawn, withheld; 3. different from, separate, न वृक्षवृत्तिव्यतिरिक्तसाधनः K.S.v.22.

व्यतिरेक m. 1. Excelling, excellence; 2. distinction, difference; 3. dissimilarity, contrast; 4. exclusion; 5. a figure of speech in which the Upameya is shown to be superior to the Upamāna in particular respects, (उपमानाद् यदत्यस्य व्यतिरेकः स एव सः K.Pr.x.); 6. logical discontinuance (as op. to अन्वय) (in Nyāya phil.).
व्यतिरेकिन् a. (f. णी) 1. Excelling; 2. excepting; 3. implying negation or nonexistence.
व्यतिरेकिन् a. (f. णी) 1. Excelling; 2. excepting; 3. implying negation or nonexistence.
व्यतिषक्त a. (f. क्ता) 1. Joined together, united; 2. interwoven, intermixed.
व्यतिषक्त a. (f. क्ता) 1. Joined together, united; 2. interwoven, intermixed.
व्यतिषंग m. 1. Reciprocal connection; 2. union, junction; 3. intermixture.
व्यति(ती)हार m. 1. Exchange, barter; 2. reciprocity, R.xii.93.
व्यति(ती)हार m. 1. Exchange, barter; 2. reciprocity, R.xii.93.
व्यतीत a. (f. ता) 1. Past away, past over, gone, R.v.14; 2. departed from, left, abandoned; 3. disregarded.
व्यतीत a. (f. ता) 1. Past away, past over, gone, R.v.14; 2. departed from, left, abandoned; 3. disregarded.
व्यतीपात m. 1. A portent indicative of a great calamity; 2. disrespect, contempt.
व्यत्यय m. 1. Opposition, contrariety; 2. interchange, transmutation; 3. inverted order.
व्यत्यस्त a. (f. स्ता) 1. Inverted, reversed; 2. contrary, opposite.
व्यत्यस्त a. (f. स्ता) 1. Inverted, reversed; 2. contrary, opposite.
व्यत्यास m. 1. Opposition, contrariety; 2. inverted order.

व्यथ् vi. 1Ā (pres. व्यथते) 1. To be sorry, to be vexed, to be agitated, to be disquieted, न विव्यथे तस्य मनः Kir.i.2, तवाभिधानाद् व्यथते नताननः Kir.i.24, Bg.xi.34; 2. to be afraid of; 3. to dry, to become dry.
व्यथ् Caus. (व्यथयति-ते) to vex, to trouble, to distress.
व्यथक a. (f. थिका) Causing pain, painful, distressing, Kir.ii.4.
व्यथक a. (f. थिका) Causing pain, painful, distressing, Kir.ii.4.
व्यथन n. Giving pain.
व्यथा f. 1. Pain, agony, anguish, कटाक्षविशिखो निर्मातु मर्मव्यथाम् Git.G.iii., R.xii.78; 2. disquietude, perturbation; 3. fear, alarm, स्वंतमित्यलघयत् स तद्व्यथाम् R.xi.62.
व्यथित a. (f. ता) 1. Distressed, afflicted; 2. troubled, disquieted; 3. alarmed.
व्यथित a. (f. ता) 1. Distressed, afflicted; 2. troubled, disquieted; 3. alarmed.

व्यध् vt. 4P (pp. विद्ध; pres. विध्यति) 1. To strike, to hurt, to stab, शब्दायमानमव्यार्सीद् भयदं क्षणदाचरम् Bt.v.52, R.ix.60; 2. to pick; 3. to pierce, to perforate (as a jewel).With अनु-, 1. to pierce, to wound; 2. to intertwine.With अप-, 1. To cast away, to throw away; 2. to pierce, हृदयमशरणं मे पक्ष्मलाक्ष्याः कटाक्षैरपहृतमपविद्धं पीतमुन्मूलितं च M.M.i.With आ-, to throw, to pierce.With परि-, to pierce, to wound.
व्यध m. 1. Striking, smiting; 2. splitting; 3. perforating.
व्याध m. 1. A hunter, a fowler (also one by caste); 2. a low man.
व्यधिकरण n. The subsisting in different substrata.(व्यधिकरणबहुव्रीहि ‘a Bahu. compound whose first member is not in apposition to the second when dissolved.’)
व्यध्य m. A target, a butt.
व्यध्व n. A bad road.
व्यनुनाद m. Reverberation.
व्यप् vt. 10U (pres. व्यापयति-ते) 1. To diminish, to lessen; 2. to throw.
व्यपकृष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) Taken off, taken away, removed.
व्यपकृष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) Taken off, taken away, removed.
व्यपगत a. (f. ता) 1. Gone away; 2. removed, disappeared, Megh.ii.13.
व्यपगत a. (f. ता) 1. Gone away; 2. removed, disappeared, Megh.ii.13.
व्यपगम m. Departure.
व्यपत्रप a. (f. पा) Shameless.
व्यपत्रप a. (f. पा) Shameless.
व्यपदिष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Represented, signified, shown; 2. pleaded as a pretext.
व्यपदिष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Represented, signified, shown; 2. pleaded as a pretext.

व्यपदेश m. 1. Representation, notice, hint; 2. naming, designation by name; 3. fraud, trick, pretext; 4. a name, an appellation; 5. family, race; 6. fame, renown, repute, व्यपदेशमाविलयितुं किमीहसे Sak.v.
व्यपरोपण n. 1. Extirpating, rooting up; 2. removing, expelling; 3. cutting off, चुकोप तस्मै स भृशं सुरश्रियः प्रसह्य केशव्यपरोपणादिव R.iii.56.
व्यपाकृति f. 1. Denial; 2. driving away, repelling.
व्यपाश्रय m. Taking refuge with, trusting to, having recourse to, depending on, Bg.iii.18.
व्यपेक्षा f. 1. Mutual regard; 2. mutual relation; 3. regard, consideration; 4. expectation; 5. the mutual application of two rules (in gram.).
व्यपेत a. (f. ता) 1. Severed, separated; 2. gone, departed.
व्यपेत a. (f. ता) 1. Severed, separated; 2. gone, departed.
व्यपोढ a. (f. ढा) 1. Expelled, removed; 2. manifested, exhibited, displayed; 3. contrary, opposite.
व्यपोढ a. (f. ढा) 1. Expelled, removed; 2. manifested, exhibited, displayed; 3. contrary, opposite.
व्यपोह m. Driving away, keeping off.

व्यभि(भी)चार m. 1. Going away from, deviating, deviation, मां च योऽव्यभिचारेण भक्तियोगेन सेवते Bg.xiv.26; 2. error, transgression, crime; 3. faithlessness, infidelity (of a wife or husband), वाङ्महझ्कर्मभिः पत्यौ व्यभिचारो यथा न मे । तथा विश्वंभरे देवि मामंतर्धातुमर्हसि R.xv.81; 4. irregularity, anomaly; 5. a fallacious Hetu, one without the Sādhya (in logic).

व्यभि(भी)चार m. 1. Going away from, deviating, deviation, मां च योऽव्यभिचारेण भक्तियोगेन सेवते Bg.xiv.26; 2. error, transgression, crime; 3. faithlessness, infidelity (of a wife or husband), वाङ्महझ्कर्मभिः पत्यौ व्यभिचारो यथा न मे । तथा विश्वंभरे देवि मामंतर्धातुमर्हसि R.xv.81; 4. irregularity, anomaly; 5. a fallacious Hetu, one without the Sādhya (in logic).
व्यभिचारिणी f. Au adulteress.
व्यभिचारिन् (I) a. (f. णी) 1. Erring, going astray; 2. irregular, anomalous; 3. untrue, unfaithful, adulterous.
व्यभिचारिन् (I) a. (f. णी) 1. Erring, going astray; 2. irregular, anomalous; 3. untrue, unfaithful, adulterous.

व्यभिचारिन् (II) m. A transitory feeling, (op. to स्थायिन्), which does not pervade a composition but, if properly developed at any stage, strengthens the prevailing sentiment; (these are thirty-three or thirty-four; for an enumeration of them, See K.Pr.iv.31-34). (See भाव, विभाव, स्थायिभाव.)
व्यय् (I) vt. 1U (pres. व्ययति-ते) To go, to move.
व्यय् (II) vt. 10U (pres. व्यययति-ते) 1. To go, to move; 2. to give, to bestow, to expend.
व्यय् (III) vt. 10U (pres. व्याययति-ते) To drive.
व्यय (I) a. (f. या) Mutable, liable to decay, perishable.

व्यय (II) m. 1. Loss, waste, आपाद्यते न व्ययमांतरायैः कच्चिन्महर्षेस्त्रिविधं तपस्तत् R.v.5; 2. decay, decline, downfall, misfortune; 3. spending expense, expenditure, अर्थस्य संग्रहे चैनां व्यये चैव नियोजयेत् M.ix.11, R.v.12; 4. obstacle.
व्यय (I) a. (f. या) Mutable, liable to decay, perishable.
व्यय-शुद्धि f. defraying of expenses.
व्ययित a. (f. ता) 1. Declined, fallen into decay, wasted; 2. spent, expended.
व्ययित a. (f. ता) 1. Declined, fallen into decay, wasted; 2. spent, expended.
व्यर्थ a. (f. र्था) 1. Useless, fruitless, unprofitable, vain, K.S.iii.75; 2. unmeaning.
व्यर्थ a. (f. र्था) 1. Useless, fruitless, unprofitable, vain, K.S.iii.75; 2. unmeaning.
व्यलीक (I) a. (f. का) 1. False; 2. disagreeable, displeasing, offensive.
व्यलीक (II) m. 1. A libertine; 2. a catamite.

व्यलीक (III) n. 1. Anything displeasing, इत्थं गिरः प्रियतमा इव सोऽव्यलीकाः Sis.v.1; 2. any cause of uneasiness, pain, grief, सुतनु हृदयात्प्रत्ययादेशव्यलीकमपैतु ते किमपि मनसः संमोहो मे तदा बलवानभूत् Sak.vii., K.S.iii.25, Kir.iii.19; 3. improper conduct, fault, transgression, सुदृशः सरसव्यलीकतप्तस्तरसा श्लिष्टवतः स यौवनोष्मा Sis.ix.85; 4. cheating; 5. falsehood.
व्यलीक (I) a. (f. का) 1. False; 2. disagreeable, displeasing, offensive.
व्यवकलन n. 1. Separation; 2. subtraction (in math.).
व्यावकलन n. Subtraction (in math.).
व्यवक्रोशन n. Mutual abuse.
व्यवच्छिन्न a. (f. न्ना) 1. Cut off, torn asunder; 2. divided, separated; 3. interrupted; 4. distinguished, particularized.
व्यवच्छिन्न a. (f. न्ना) 1. Cut off, torn asunder; 2. divided, separated; 3. interrupted; 4. distinguished, particularized.
व्यवच्छेद m. 1. Cutting off; 2. dividing, separating; 3. particularizing, distinguishing; 4. discharging, letting fly (as an arrow); 5. a chapter or section of a book.
व्यवधा f. Anything which intervenes, a screen, a covering, a partition.

व्यवधान n. 1. Intervention, interposition; 2. screening, hiding from sight, दृष्टिं विमानव्यवधानमुक्तां पुनस्सहस्रार्चिषि सन्निधत्ते R.xiii.44; 3. a screen, a partition; 4. a cover, a covering; 5. interval, space.
व्यवधि m. The same as व्यवधान q.v.

व्यवसाय m. 1. Resolve, settled determination, Bg.ii.41, x.36; 2. exertion, effort, industry, perseverance, K.S.iv.45; 3. action, performance, व्यवसायः प्रतिपत्तिनिष्ठुरः R.viii.65; 4. conduct, behaviour; 5. trade, business; 6. plan, device; 7. boasting; 8. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
व्यवसित a. (f. ता) 1. Settled, decided, determined; 2. endeavoured, undertaken; 3. persevering; 4. planned; 5. cheated, deceived.
व्यवसित a. (f. ता) 1. Settled, decided, determined; 2. endeavoured, undertaken; 3. persevering; 4. planned; 5. cheated, deceived.

व्यवस्था f. 1. Arrangement, settlement, order, R.vii.54; 2. fixity, firm basis, आजह्रतुस्तच्चरणौ पृथिव्यां स्थलारविंदश्रियमव्यवस्थाम् K.S.i.33; 3. relative position; 4. a rule, a statute, a decree, a decision, a legal opinion (specially applied to a statement of the proper adjustment of contradictory texts); 5. agreement, contract.
व्यवस्थान n. 1. Steadiness; 2. regular arrangement, settlement, determination; 3. rule, decision; 4. firmness, perseverance.
व्यवस्थापक a. (f. पिका) 1. Settling, arranging in order, deciding, establishing; 2. supervising.
व्यवस्थापक a. (f. पिका) 1. Settling, arranging in order, deciding, establishing; 2. supervising.
व्यवस्थापन n. 1. Fixing, determining, deciding; 2. arranging properly.
व्यवस्थित a. (f. ता) 1. Standing apart; 2. adjusted properly, arranged in order; 3. fixed, settled; 4. decided, declared, determined; 5. extracted, (pp. of स्था with व्यव q.v.).
व्यवस्थित a. (f. ता) 1. Standing apart; 2. adjusted properly, arranged in order; 3. fixed, settled; 4. decided, declared, determined; 5. extracted, (pp. of स्था with व्यव q.v.).
व्यवस्थिति f. The same as व्यवस्थान q.v.
व्यवहर्तृ m. 1. The manager of a business; 2. a litigant, one who institutes an action at law; 3. a judge.

व्यवहार m. 1. Practice, conduct, behaviour; 2. business, profession; 3. affair; 4. trade, commerce; 5. custom, usage; 6. a contract; 7. administration of justice, judicial procedure, व्यवहारपराधीनतया दुष्करं खलु परचित्तग्रहणमधिकरणिकैः Mrich.ix.; 8. a lawsuit, a legal dispute, ददर्श संशयच्छेद्यान् व्यवाहारानतंद्रितः R.xvii.39; 9. a title of legal procedure.
व्यवहार-अंग n. the body of civil and criminal law.
व्यवहार-आसन n. the court of justice.
व्यवहार-ज्ञ m. 1. a person who is acquainted with legal procedure; 2. a person who understands business; 3. a young man come of age.
व्यवहार-दर्शन n. judicial investigation.
व्यवहार-पद n. an occasion of litigation, a head of legal procedure.
व्यवहार-पाद m. the fourth stage in the conduct of a law-suit, that which concerns the decision.
व्यवहार-मातृका f. any subject relating to the administration of justice.
व्यवहार-विधि m. rule of law.
व्यवहार-विषय m. a head of legal procedure, a matter which can be made a subject of legal proceedings; (these are eighteen, for an enumeration of which, See M.viii.4-7).
व्यवहारक m. A dealer, a trader.
व्यवहारिक a. (f. का or की) 1. Relating to business; 2. relating to legal process; 3. customary, usual.
व्यवहारिक a. (f. का or की) 1. Relating to business; 2. relating to legal process; 3. customary, usual.
व्यवहारिका f. 1. Usage, custom; 2. a broom; 3. the Ingudī plant.
व्यावहारिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Relating to business; 2. relating to judicial procedure; 3. customary, usual; 4. relating to the worldly life of illusion (in Vedānta phil.).
व्यावहारिक (II) m. A counsellor.
व्यवहारिक a. (f. का or की) 1. Relating to business; 2. relating to legal process; 3. customary, usual.
व्यावहारिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Relating to business; 2. relating to judicial procedure; 3. customary, usual; 4. relating to the worldly life of illusion (in Vedānta phil.).
व्यवहारिन् a. (f. णी) 1. Transacting business; 2. litigating; 3. customary, usual.
व्यवहारिन् a. (f. णी) 1. Transacting business; 2. litigating; 3. customary, usual.

व्यवहित a. (f. ता) 1. Separated, interrupted; 2. concealed, screened from view; 3. obstructed, impeded; 4. done, performed; 5. omitted, passed over; 6. surpassed, excelled; 7. not immediately connected.

व्यवहित a. (f. ता) 1. Separated, interrupted; 2. concealed, screened from view; 3. obstructed, impeded; 4. done, performed; 5. omitted, passed over; 6. surpassed, excelled; 7. not immediately connected.
व्यवहृति f. Practice, performance.
व्यवाय (I) m. 1. Separation, decomposition; 2. copulation, sexual intercourse; 3. concealment, covering; 4. obstacle, impediment; 5. purification.
व्यवाय (II) n. Light, lustre.
